name: Champaign Park District Teen Volunteering
what_you_do: You can volunteer at parks and programs. Examples include special events and Prairie Farm (May to August). Others are Virginia Theatre, sports and summer programs.
who_can_apply: Teens at least 13 years old who are enthusiastic, hardworking and willing to learn. Teen volunteers may work at most 25 hours a week.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Hours can count toward high school volunteer requirements.
deadline_text: No deadline. Volunteers register on the Champaign Park District Volunteer Portal.
how_to_apply: Create an account on the Champaign Park District Volunteer Portal, then view opportunities. Questions: volunteer@champaignparks.org.
notes: Some roles (for example Prairie Farm) run only part of the year.
